posts.title: Thanksgiving is hard, but it’s only in thanksgiving that we’re made well – whole and complete….
posts.description: Skipping Thanksgiving Thanksgiving is hard, but it’s only in thanksgiving that we’re made well – whole and complete. Skipping thanksgiving is more than just moving on to Christmas. It’s missing a vital element of life itself – the moment we get to talk to Jesus and hear Jesus talk to us.
